slides.title: Up ==80%==, then ==30% off==. The answer is not 50%.

slides.stem: A clothing retailer marks up cost by 80% and then offers a 30% clearance discount. What is the overall percent change from cost to the clearance price?
slides.prompt: Time yourself. Comment your time and your answer.

slides.title: A — 26% increase
slides.body: Net multiplier = 1.80 × 0.70 = 1.26, a 26% increase. Most students pick B (50% increase): added 80% − 30% = 50% instead of compounding.

slides.title: Net Effect of Successive Percent Changes
slides.body: The net change from multipliers m₁ and m₂ is m₁ m₂ − 1 as a percent. Never add or subtract the percent values.
